summary: Bruno's scripting API: variables, environments, cookies, the collection runner, and sending requests from a script.

signature: sendRequest(config: string | object, callback?: (error: any, response: SendRequestResponse | null) => void | Promise<void>): Promise<SendRequestResponse>
summary: Send an HTTP request from the script and resolve with its response.
description:
Takes an axios request config (`method`, `url`, `headers`, `data`, `timeout`, …) or just a
URL. The request goes through the collection's proxy and certificate settings. Without a
callback the promise rejects on a network error or a 4xx/5xx status; with one, the callback
gets `(error, response)` instead, and `error.status` holds the HTTP status.

params.name: config
params.description: An axios request config, or the URL to GET.

params.name: callback
params.type: (error: any, response: SendRequestResponse | null) => void | Promise<void>
params.description: Called with `(error, response)` once the request settles.

returns.description: The response.

summary: The cookies of the current request's URL, read from and written to the app's cookie jar.
description: Reads are synchronous; writes return a promise. `bru.cookies.jar()` reaches cookies of any URL.
examples:
const sessionId = bru.cookies.get('sid');
await bru.cookies.upsert({ key: 'lang', value: 'en' });

signature: add(cookieObj: CookieInput, callback?: (error?: Error | undefined) => void): void | Promise<void>
summary: Set a cookie for the current request's URL. The same as `upsert()`.

params.name: cookieObj
params.description: The cookie, with at least `key` and `value`.

params.name: callback
params.description: Called once the cookie is set. Without it, a promise is returned.

returns.description: A promise when no callback is given.

signature: upsert(cookieObj: CookieInput, callback?: (error?: Error | undefined) => void): void | Promise<void>
summary: Set a cookie for the current request's URL, replacing a cookie of the same name.
description: Rejects when `cookieObj` is not an object.
examples: await bru.cookies.upsert({ key: 'sid', value: 'abc123', secure: true });

params.name: cookieObj
params.description: The cookie, with at least `key` and `value`.

params.name: callback
params.description: Called once the cookie is set. Without it, a promise is returned.

returns.description: A promise when no callback is given.

signature: remove(name: string, callback?: (error?: Error | undefined) => void): void | Promise<void>
summary: Delete a cookie of the current request's URL by name. Nothing happens when there is none.

params.name: callback
params.description: Called once the cookie is deleted. Without it, a promise is returned.

returns.description: A promise when no callback is given.

signature: clear(callback?: (error?: Error | undefined) => void): void | Promise<void>
